gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi reads wide and sturdy, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. College draws every curve as heavy as its stems, and that shared pull is the best thing the two have going.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada has a gentle step up from small letters to capitals, with s curves that open wide at both ends. College counters with stems and curves cut to one width.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li reads clean and light, with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes. College sits beside it like vinyl cut to a single line width, and its tall lowercase gives the page a firm backbone.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kharosht: Noto Sans Kharoshthi leaves its curves open and lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Noto Sans Kharoshthi feels friendly next to College, whose pen pressure never wavers from first letter to last.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Chunky, upright, and sure of itself. Noto Sans Khmer follows with generous openings like chisel notches, and its near-capital-sized small letters keep a long page of text feeling bold.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Big, round, and loud, with horizontals as thick as the verticals. Noto Sans Khojki steps in with wide exits and a large eye on every e, and the light it lets through is what makes this pair work.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-khudawad: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Khudawadi, which keeps capitals and lowercase close in height and leaves its rounds unlatched. College holds its downstrokes as light as its upstrokes.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kr: College opens with big counters and no hairlines at all. Noto Sans KR follows with generous gaps in its curves and stubby ascenders under a big x-height, so a long passage would read smoothly.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao sits tall, its x-height pushed well above the usual. College is drawn like bent pipe, and Noto Sans Lao would carry a long passage with its mouths staying open.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lao-loop: College holds its lines at a single thickness, with big counters in a tall lowercase. Noto Sans Lao Looped turns words into solid blocks rather than skylines, so a long passage would feel dense but never cramped.
